title: Dune
blurb: Frank Herbert's novel filmed twice: David Lynch's 1984 version, which squeezes the whole book into one film, and Denis Villeneuve's, which splits it in two.

groups.title: David Lynch's Dune
groups.note: A single-film adaptation of the whole novel.

groups.title: Denis Villeneuve's films
groups.note: Part Two begins where the first ends. Part Three is due in December 2026.

note: The two adaptations are unconnected, so start with either. Villeneuve's two films are halves of one adaptation rather than a film and its sequel.
